description: Executed opcodes and execution gas per runtime benchmark case, summed over the hot-profile calls that succeeded under all three compilers and that the runtime bench compares. Traced with blog/solar-blog-evidence/opcodes/tracer.js through anvil debug_traceTransaction. Execution gas excludes intrinsic gas and adds back applied refunds. gas objective: Solar -Ogas and solc at the case's optimizer runs; size objective: optimizer runs 1 (Solar -Osize).
